decision: Reject the fused attention candidate and restore the faster existing production plan. Overall hardware-limit goal remains active.
hardware_software: Ryzen AI 7 H 350 / XDNA2 AIE2P / 8 columns / performance power mode / XRT 2.25.00 / firmware 1.0.0.63 / Linux 7.0.0-38-generic / project-locked MLIR-AIE and Peano
candidate_design: Fuse LayerNorm, six shift/mix branches and all attention matrix projections into one 17-core program per layer
Pair R/K/V weights and outputs across adjacent worker cores, reducing matrix DMA stream count to make room for normalization
Keep routing and intermediate reuse on-chip while retaining existing diagnostic outputs and FP32 state
Use five BO arguments, direct raw value/gate output into the existing recurrence arena, and a packed diagnostic/state/rank BO
No model or arithmetic change, no quantization change, same BF16 matrix reduction order

validation.stage: Both three- and four-branch stages pass exact equivalence versus original two submissions over three replays, FP64 normalization oracle, immutable input/weight checks and BO guards
validation.initial_integrated_candidate: Both BF16/INT8 128-token golden regressions passed with 1116 vectors including 960 first-token nodes; 99 runs/token

whole_model_benchmark.conditions: Serial NPU, no profiling or compilation during timed runs. Saved pre-change executable/artifacts versus integrated candidate executable/artifacts; a different ABI prevents using one executable for both.

updated_profiles.limits: Instrumented host elapsed stage time includes context switching, scheduling, DMA and arithmetic. This does not isolate PDI loading or prove a particular hardware stall cause.

failed_variants: Strided paired-weight DMA exceeded a hardware dimension limit; contiguous offline packing compiled
Nine- and eight-BO fused variants failed in XRT wait; a five-BO packed variant dispatched. No universal argument-count limit is inferred from these experiments.
Sharing old-state storage with normalized diagnostic output changed a diagnostic vector; retained distinct slots for this candidate
interpretation: A large isolated gain (~2.2 ms for two submissions to ~1.0 ms for one warm submission) did not translate to end-to-end throughput. Fewer runs and BOs alone are insufficient evidence to retain a fusion.
